title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11644)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard specifies the tolerances of form and position applicable to all types of metric bolts and screws in nominal diameter range 3 to 24 mm used in aerospace construction.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Geometrical tolerancing on Technical Drawings, Part 1: Tolerances of form orientation, location and Run-out and appropriate geometrical definitions
Technical drawings - Geometrical tolerancing, Part 2: Maximum material principles

dimensional_tolerances: tolerances shall conform to Table 2 for nominal thread diameter from 3 to 24 mm
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
